# Carcavelos Daily Brief – 06/09/2026

**Tiny and glassy: a textbook dawn patrol day.**

This morning (04:17–11:00) delivers your cleanest window with 1.1m waves and barely-there 3–5 km/h winds. Head out between **06:00–09:00** for the most protected conditions and longest rides on this gentle NW swell. Water's a pleasant 20–21°C, air temps climbing steadily.

Afternoon tells a different story. Winds trend north and ramp up significantly—expect 13–17 km/h by 16:00. Wave heights creep to 1.2m by late day, but chop builds fast. The swell period shortens slightly (10.3s → 8.4s), losing that dreamy shoulder.

**Three tips:** grab a fish or hybrid for these playful conditions; hit it early before the wind picks up; crowds thin out post-10am as thermals kick in—use that to your advantage if you're chasing uncrowded sets.
